standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: Individual timber boards retain their alternating layout with visible warm grain and eased edges.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves the full square module and consistent plank spacing.

detail.note: Close view shows fine grain on the separate boards and restrained rounded corners.

underside.note: The original dark backing remains continuous and closed under every board.

clay.note: Board relief and the layered perimeter remain readable without materials.

front.note: The bowl is recognizable, but pointed decorative rods intrude through its inner wall.

rear.note: The same tooth-like rod ends repeat around the rim rather than a coherent scalloped shell.

detail.note: Full detail shows sharp internal tips and coarse outer wall facets; smooth bounded construction is needed.

underside.note: Full underside reveals an open lower annulus around a raised inner disc, confirmed by the source ring topology.

clay.note: Clay confirms the incomplete lower shell and penetrating rods remain geometry defects.

front.note: The oval basin has a clear recess and restrained stone finish above the slender brass console.

rear.note: The rear ledge, lower shelf and legs remain connected and aligned.

detail.note: The rounded basin lip and stone surface read clearly; exposed plumbing remains an inherited omission.

underside.note: The basin bottom is closed and the original crossrails and shelf supports remain intact.

clay.note: The actual bowl recess and open console construction remain legible without color.

front.note: The bowl and finely fluted pedestal retain a coherent porcelain fixture silhouette.

rear.note: The tap ledge and pedestal meet the basin without new gaps.

detail.note: The continuous recessed bowl and narrow lip show smoother surface response while retaining the original design.

underside.note: The basin bottom is closed; the pedestal's original underside opening remains a plausible plumbing access limitation.

clay.note: Bowl depth and vertical pedestal flutes remain readable in clay.

front.note: The thin-rim oval vessel retains its genuine recess and a softly finished ceramic exterior.

rear.note: The opposite view shows a continuous wall without a seam or silhouette regression.

detail.note: The fine lip and curved inner floor remain distinct; the white finish is intentionally plain.

underside.note: The bottom is closed and the bowl rests on its original flattened base.

clay.note: The recessed interior and thin rim remain clear without materials.

front.note: The asymmetric bowl, rear ledge and offset tap retain their recognizable wall-mounted layout.

rear.note: The rear mounting plate remains attached to the bowl and tap ledge.

detail.note: The rounded interior and small chrome tap show restrained surface refinement.

underside.note: The closed bowl bottom and connected mounting plate remain visible below.

clay.note: Asymmetric basin depth and the raised rear ledge remain legible in clay.

front.note: The drum's separate vertical flutes and thin bronze rim remain crisp with eased surface highlights.

rear.note: The circular silhouette and repeated flute spacing remain consistent from behind.

detail.note: The rim and dense rounded flutes have readable separation; the top remains an inherited plain timber color.

underside.note: A closed circular bottom and recessed foot support the drum construction.

clay.note: Flute relief and the layered rim remain distinct without materials.

front.note: The smoked top remains clear, but the supporting arches have conspicuously polygonal bends and cross sections.

rear.note: The opposite view repeats the angular arch silhouette below the glass.

detail.note: Full detail shows broad longitudinal facets and abrupt changes around the laminated arch; a smooth measured sweep is needed.

underside.note: The support pads and closed arch ends remain intact, so the defect is the coarse support construction.

clay.note: Clay exposes the polygonal supports even without the glass coloration.

front.note: The waterfall top and end slabs retain eased edges and their original marble artwork.

rear.note: Both end slabs remain joined to the top with the original narrow reveals.

detail.note: The stylized looping marble image is preserved; the improvement is edge and surface refinement, not photorealistic veining.

underside.note: The underside is closed and both broad end supports remain attached.

clay.note: The waterfall construction and small reveals remain legible in clay.

front.note: The top, fitted front and open lower shelf retain a clean layered storage-table construction.

rear.note: The rear case and small feet stay aligned with the rounded top.

detail.note: The narrow pull, eased front edge and shelf opening remain distinct; the timber color is still plain.

underside.note: The closed case bottom and four feet remain connected without missing panels.

clay.note: The shelf and fitted drawer relief remain readable without color.

front.note: The oval stone slab has restrained mottling and a smooth profile over two broad trestles.

rear.note: The paired trestles and cross stretcher remain connected from the opposite side.

detail.note: The slab edge and rounded timber supports show gentle highlights and clear material separation.

underside.note: The recessed underside layer and both trestle contacts remain complete.

clay.note: The oval top and connected trestle construction are clear without color.

front.note: Five fitted fronts preserve the narrow dresser silhouette with restrained eased edges.

rear.note: The closed rear and short timber feet remain complete.

detail.note: Thin drawer gaps and brass pulls are visible; the oak surface remains an inherited plain finish.

underside.note: The case bottom and four feet are closed and connected.

clay.note: Five separate drawer fronts remain readable without materials.

front.note: The compact three-drawer case retains its warm color and softly finished fitted top.

rear.note: Rear panel and feet remain aligned without new gaps.

detail.note: Brass pulls and narrow drawer reveals stay legible; detailed walnut grain is not claimed.

underside.note: The bottom panel and four short feet remain complete.

clay.note: The three fitted fronts and supported case remain clear in clay.

front.note: The slim refrigerator preserves its two doors and narrow recessed pulls with cleaner edge response.

rear.note: The closed rear case and small original fittings remain intact.

detail.note: Separate freezer and lower-door gaps remain readable against the plain white finish.

underside.note: The base is closed and the door edges remain aligned below.

clay.note: Two-door construction and recessed handle lines remain visible without color.

front.note: The cream refrigerator retains rounded door edges and separate vertical handles.

rear.note: The rear case remains closed and aligned with both doors.

detail.note: Soft corners, narrow door gap and attached handle standoffs remain clear.

underside.note: The original closed base remains intact with no unsupported door section.

clay.note: The two-door layout and raised handles remain legible in clay.

front.note: The blue-grey steel case retains its separate freezer and lower doors with restrained metal response.

rear.note: The plain closed rear remains complete and aligned.

detail.note: Handle shapes, door division and narrow edge highlights remain clear without excessive gloss.

underside.note: The base remains closed and the door stack stays aligned.

clay.note: The raised pulls and two-door silhouette remain readable without color.

front.note: The thin rubber mat retains a dense raised diamond pattern and separate border.

rear.note: Opposite view preserves the continuous backing and regular raised grid.

detail.note: Each molded diamond has visible thickness and subdued rubber highlights.

underside.note: The dark backing remains completely closed and flat.

clay.note: Raised diamonds and the perimeter border remain visible in clay.

front.note: The mat retains a coherent raised scraper lattice with softly eased edges.

rear.note: The crossing bars and border remain connected across the full backing.

detail.note: The close view shows layered lattice intersections and restrained rubber surface detail.

underside.note: The thin original backing is closed without holes beneath the raised pattern.

clay.note: Grid relief remains readable without the dark material.

front.note: Closely spaced scraper ribs remain legible within the thin rounded border.

rear.note: The rib spacing and continuous backing are consistent from behind.

detail.note: Narrow rib relief and subdued surface response remain clear at close range.

underside.note: The backing is closed and flat across the whole mat.

clay.note: Parallel ribs and the raised border remain readable in clay.

front.note: The ribbed left door and four open shelf bays retain the intended asymmetric layout.

rear.note: The full rear panel and short feet remain complete.

detail.note: The individual door ribs, shelf junctions and narrow pull remain clear; the timber finish is still simple.

underside.note: The long closed case bottom and four feet remain attached.

clay.note: The contrasting closed and open compartments remain distinct in clay.

front.note: The two actual cane lattice doors flank the open equipment bay with cleaner frame edges.

rear.note: Rear panel and short feet remain complete and aligned.

detail.note: Fine crossing cane strands remain open and distinct inside their solid door frames.

underside.note: The closed bottom, center shelf and four feet remain connected.

clay.note: The lattice holes and central shelving survive without color.

front.note: The white wall unit retains three fitted fronts and restrained brass reveals.

rear.note: The original long rear mounting cleat remains attached and visible.

detail.note: Door borders, small pulls and softened case edges stay legible against the plain lacquer finish.

underside.note: The full-width bottom panel is closed with no unsupported front section.

clay.note: The three-door layout and floating case construction remain clear in clay.

front.note: The long walnut-colored console retains three densely ribbed fronts with subtle edge refinement.

rear.note: The closed rear and four short feet remain aligned.

detail.note: Individual tambour reeds and small pulls remain readable; the plain timber color is an inherited limitation.

underside.note: The bottom panel remains closed and supported by its original feet.

clay.note: The three separated ribbed fronts remain clear without materials.

front.note: The arched mirror is readable, but the frame has a kink at the left arch-to-upright transition.

rear.note: The opposite side confirms the same discontinuity in the frame silhouette.

detail.note: Full detail shows a twisted brass seam where the curved crown meets the vertical rail; the sweep needs continuous orientation.

underside.note: The reflective panel and narrow inner reveal remain present and must be preserved.

clay.note: The frame junction remains uneven in clay, so material refinement does not resolve it.

front.note: The octagonal mirror retains its panel, but both long timber rails pinch sharply at mid-height.

rear.note: The same hourglass distortion is visible in the opposite frame edges.

detail.note: Full detail confirms the vertical rail cross sections collapse into thin twisted waists instead of constant-width frame members.

underside.note: The reflective panel and inner reveal remain intact; repair should retain the original outer octagonal envelope.

clay.note: Clay exposes the pinched rails independently of the wood material.

front.note: The original diamond artwork remains intact with fine textile surface response and a thin binding.

rear.note: The complete pattern and narrow fringes remain consistent from the opposite side.

detail.note: Original line motifs stay readable; the refinement does not replace or redraw the authored artwork.

underside.note: The continuous textile backing is closed across the whole rug.

clay.note: The thin bound shape remains appropriate in clay; the principal design is intentionally carried by the protected image.

front.note: The original lotus border and blue field remain clear with restrained textile grain.

rear.note: The border artwork and small fringe ends remain intact from behind.

detail.note: Lotus shapes and geometric border lines retain their original colors and detail.

underside.note: The backing remains closed and the narrow binding stays aligned.

clay.note: The thin rug construction remains coherent without claiming the painted pattern is modeled relief.

front.note: The original red-and-blue geometric artwork remains legible on the thin bound rug.

rear.note: The complete repeated pattern and fringe layout remain consistent from the opposite side.

detail.note: The diamond motifs retain their image detail while the surface reads as restrained textile.

underside.note: The original backing stays continuous and closed.

clay.note: The flat bound construction remains appropriate; the protected pattern is not falsely described as new geometry.

front.note: The dense original floral medallion and border remain readable with subdued textile response.

rear.note: The opposite view retains the full image and aligned binding.

detail.note: The intricate original motifs are preserved without a coarse normal pattern obscuring them.

underside.note: The backing is closed and the edge remains thin and continuous.

clay.note: The bound rug shape remains coherent in clay; its detailed pattern is intentionally image-based.

front.note: The indigo field and small original stitch motifs remain distinct with restrained cloth grain.

rear.note: Pattern spacing and narrow edge binding remain consistent from behind.

detail.note: The small pale stitches remain legible rather than being overwhelmed by the surface texture.

underside.note: The full backing is closed with no loose or unsupported corner.

clay.note: The thin layered textile form remains clear; the stitch design remains deliberately subtle.

front.note: The pale woven field and indigo side bindings retain a clear tatami silhouette.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves the full rush surface and straight bound sides.

detail.note: Fine parallel rush detail remains visible with restrained roughness and intact blue edging.

underside.note: The backing is closed and the side bindings remain aligned with it.

clay.note: Thin mat construction and the raised edge strips remain visible without materials.

front.note: The recessed basin is clear, but open triangular counter corners and vertical side gaps make the installation incomplete.

rear.note: The rear view also exposes openings between the bowl rim and straight counter rails.

detail.note: Full detail confirms missing deck coverage around rounded bowl corners and unfilled gaps beside the apron.

underside.note: The lower cabinet and feet are closed and sound; the defect is confined to the upper sink installation.

clay.note: Clay retains the corner and side openings, so a fitted deck and apron support are needed.

front.note: The double bowls and fluted apron are recognizable, but open corner holes and side slots remain around the installation.

rear.note: Rear view confirms gaps between the curved basin rims and straight counter strips.

detail.note: Full detail shows exposed triangular voids and a dark vertical slot beside the apron; fitted deck coverage is needed.

underside.note: The lower case, doors and feet remain closed and connected.

clay.note: The upper installation gaps remain visible without color despite the clear bowl recesses.

front.note: The woven back and softer cushions improve the chair, but the front arm posts pinch into implausibly thin waists.

rear.note: The open cane lattice and rear frame remain complete and should be preserved.

detail.note: Full detail shows severe twisting and narrowing of both front posts plus abrupt arm bends.

underside.note: Seat frame, lower stretcher and feet remain connected; the defect is the tube sweep orientation.

clay.note: The hourglass arm supports remain obvious in clay and require a continuous round sweep.

front.note: The long upholstered chaise and open cane back remain clear, but its front arm posts collapse into thin twisted sections.

rear.note: The rear lattice and long side rails remain complete and aligned.

detail.note: Full detail confirms pinched front posts and angular arm transitions; the measured centerline needs a smooth stable sweep.

underside.note: The long lower frame and closed cushion base remain supported by the original legs.

clay.note: Clay confirms the distorted posts independently of the refined cloth and cane surfaces.
